outputs.explanation: Spatial heatmap-style plots showing cell deconvolution distributions on tissue sections; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Box plot of immune cell fractions; individual data points (dots) are overlaid on the box plots, and box plots are exempt in any case as they show the distribution.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Bar graph shows a single computed log2 fold-change value per gene from a DEG analysis (not a mean across replicate samples), so there are no underlying individual replicate data points to overlay.
Panel consists of representative H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
